paragraph: INE [released the final results of the RGPH 2024 on 20 November 2025](<https://c2a.portais.gov.ao/uploads/Relatorio_Sintese_CENSO_2024_INE_Nov_2025_c5fba11d70.pdf>), after [enumerating Angola from 19 September to 20 December 2024](<https://censo2024.ine.gov.ao/ICOLE%20E%20BENGO.pdf>). [Angop reports the count at 36,604,681 residents](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/censo-2024-luanda-continua-a-concentrar-maior-numero-da-populacao-angolana/>). In the last twelve months, INE issued provincial reports, the last for Luanda in February 2026. A [2026 Countdown 2030 report on Angola](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Angola.pdf>) measures health coverage against the results of the DHS 2023 household survey, and breaks them down by wealth, schooling and residence.

Burundi carried out its [combined population, housing, agriculture and livestock census in 2024](<https://burundi.unfpa.org/fr/news/coop%C3%A9ration-sud-sud-la-guin%C3%A9e-%C3%A9quatoriale-sinspire-de-lexp%C3%A9rience-burundaise-du-recensement>). [Decree 100/032 of 27 March 2025 published preliminary results](<https://presidence.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/decret-RGPHAE-2024.pdf>), counting 12,332,788 residents and 2,724,457 ordinary households. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Definitive results have not been found, and no source reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

The director general of INStaD [announced that main mapping for the fifth census (RGPH5) began on 19 March 2024](<https://www.banouto.bj/societe/article/20240323-recensement-general-de-la-population-au-benin-rgph5-demarrage-de-la-cartographie-principale-dans-74-communes>), covering 74 communes after a pilot in Cotonou, Cove and Parakou. The fourth census's [definitive results were adopted by the Council of Ministers on 21 May 2015](<https://instad.bj/images/docs/insae-statistiques/enquetes-recensements/RGPH/1.RGPH_4/Indicateurs-et-Projetcions/R%C3%A9sultats%20d%C3%A9finitifs%20RGPH4.pdf>). INStaD also [published the main indicators of the EHCVM survey of 2021-2022](<https://www.instad.bj/actualites/790-document-des-principaux-indicateurs-ehcvm2>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports a census counted since October 2016. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[INSD published the key final results of the 5th national population and housing census in June 2022](<https://www.insd.bf/fr/file-download/download/public/2073>). The census was enumerated in November to December 2019 and counted 20,505,155 residents. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A multisectoral continuous survey and an LSMS-ISA survey are named in sources read, with no results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

Statistics Botswana's [annual report for 2023-24 gives a 2022 count of 2,359,609 people](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/documents/Statistics%20Botswana%20Annual%20Report%202023-24.pdf>) and states the Population and Housing Census was conducted. [Minister Segokgo cites the 2022 census as the source of Botswana's population figure](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/81395>). In the last twelve months, [Statistics Botswana presented findings of the 2024 Household Access and Individual Use of ICTs Survey in September 2026](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/meetings/wp-content/uploads/IPS/documents/46/10_EGH2026_DataCollectionBotswana_TebogoTsienyane.pdf>), with fieldwork from June to August 2024. No preliminary or final results of the census have been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[In August 2026 ICASEES presented the third phase of data cleaning for the RGPH-4](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/398-icasees-la-troisieme-phase-dapurement-du-rgph-4-franchit-une-nouvelle-etape-vers-la-finalisation-des-resultats-du-recensement>), the country's first digital census. In the last twelve months, a committee [reviewed the first provisional results on 23 to 25 September 2026](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/425-icasees-retraite-de-travail-consacree-a-lapurement-et-a-la-tabulation-des-donnees-du-rgph-4>). ICASEES then [held a retreat at Boali on 2 to 5 October 2026 to clean and tabulate the data](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/427-icasees-la-mission-dappui-de-la-banque-mondiale-au-projet-hiswaca-sop2>). No preliminary or final results have been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

A [World Bank Mission 300 progress report for the first quarter of 2026](<https://www.worldbank.org/content/dam/theworldbankgroupasset/document/2026/m300-energy-compacts/progress-reports/cote-divoire-(en)_mission-300_compact-progress-report-_q12026.pdf>) bases Cote d'Ivoire's clean cooking access figure on the latest RGPH, 2021. That implies a population and housing census was counted in 2021. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No release of preliminary or final results of that census has been found, and no source reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A MICS 2026 is named in a source read, with no results dated. Operating would need preliminary or final results of the census published.

[Counting for Cameroon's 4th general population and housing census, launched on 24 April 2026, closed on 15 September 2026](<https://fr.journalducameroun.com/cameroun-le-4e-recensement-general-de-la-population-et-de-lhabitat-sacheve/>). It was coupled with the agriculture and livestock census. In the last twelve months, [a Prime Minister's order made public on 31 July 2026](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/79313/en.html/details_2>) set a complementary enumeration from 1 August to 15 September 2026 to find households not yet counted. [The government, with FAO and UNFPA, field-tested a hybrid method in October and November 2025](<https://www.fao.org/cameroun/news/detail/cameroon-tests-an-innovative-census-strategy-in-crisis-zones/en>). No preliminary or final results have been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[Census-cartography operations for the second census (RGPH-2) were launched on 28 September 2026](<https://mail.7sur7.cd/index.php/2026/10/01/recensement-identification-et-enrolement-en-rdc-ce-quil-faut-savoir>), and general enumeration is planned from July 2027. In the last twelve months, [training of 1,868 census cartographic operators began in Kinshasa on 9 September 2026](<https://actualite.cd/2026/09/18/rgph-2-le-gouvernement-implique-les-operateurs-de-telecommunication-pour-renforcer-la>), with fieldwork from 15 September. [In July 2026 the Plan minister cited published results of the Demographic and Health Survey EDS III RDC 2024](<https://actualite.cd/2026/07/11/journee-mondiale-de-la-population-le-rgph-2-au-coeur-de-la-strategie-du-gouvernement>). No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

ADIAC says [the fifth general population census, RGPH-5, was conducted in December 2023](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/numerique-les-tuyaux-ont-gagne-du-terrain-lusage-cherche-encore-le-sien-171228>). In the last twelve months, on 27 November 2025 the national statistics institute [opened a workshop to validate indicators and tables drawn from it](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/statistiques-lins-ouvre-latelier-national-de-validation-des-indicateurs-du-rgph-5-168128>), where its preliminary results were on display. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the RGPH-5 published, or results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Operating would need preliminary or final results of the census published.

The [INSEED microdata archive lists the 2017 population and housing census, with data years 2017-2018, added on 24 October 2025](<https://www.nada.inseed-comores.org/index.php/home>). In the last twelve months, INSEED [released version 1.0 (April 2026) of the EHCVM 2024 survey data, a nationally representative survey of 5,487 households fielded May to November 2024](<https://www.nada.inseed-comores.org/index.php/catalog/15>). INSEED has also set up a digital cartography laboratory to prepare the fifth census, with a pilot in 50 enumeration areas. No preliminary or final results of the 2017 census have been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

The [World Bank gives 2021 as Cape Verde's latest census](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037712/world-development-indicators>), and its [SPI lists counts in 2000, 2010 and 2021](<https://github.com/worldbank/SPI>). The statistics office's own account of the 2021 count has not been found. [A July 2026 opinion piece says INE released partial poverty figures in October 2024](<https://www.anacao.cv/noticia/2026/07/25/dados-do-banco-mundial-desmascaram-os-do-ine-sobre-a-pobreza-em-cabo-verde/>), and that the full results of the income survey begun in December 2022 were still unpublished. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No release of 2021 census results has been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[INSTAD states that RGPH-3 data collection took place in April and May 2024, with provisional results published in June 2024](<https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/instad-dj.appspot.com/o/RGPH%2F0%2FTome%2020_Localit%C3%A9s%20et%20Populations%20r%C3%A9sidentes%20de%20Djibouti_18112025.pdf?alt=media&token=4d122ebf-70f1-4de4-8d13-0b20748795f5>). [UNFPA Djibouti lists the definitive-results report of the third census as published](<https://djibouti.unfpa.org/fr/publications/le-rapport-des-r%C3%A9sultats-d%C3%A9finitifs-du-troisi%C3%A8me-recensement-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-la-population>), under a site date of 1 January 2026 that may be a system default. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A MICS-7 and an EDAM5 survey are named in sources read, with no results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

The [World Bank gives 2022 as Algeria's latest census](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037712/world-development-indicators>), and its [SPI lists counts in 1998, 2008 and 2022](<https://github.com/worldbank/SPI>). The statistics office's own account of the 2022 count has not been found, and the World Bank is the only source found for any census in Algeria. The World Bank names the 2018-2019 MICS as the latest health survey and a 2011 household survey as the latest source on income. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No release of 2022 results has been found. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

The [World Bank gives 2017 as Egypt's latest census](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037712/world-development-indicators>), and its [SPI lists counts in 1996, 2006 and 2017](<https://github.com/worldbank/SPI>). In the last twelve months, [the Prime Minister chaired the High Committee for the next census in February 2026](<https://www.cabinet.gov.eg/News/Details/84892>). [On 6 August 2026 the cabinet moved the census from 2027 to 2028](<https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/8/6/3028931>), and a presidential decree is still needed to run it. No release of 2017 results has been found. The World Bank names the 2015 Health Issues Survey as the latest health survey. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[UNECA's synopsis of African population statistics, of August 2026, states that Eritrea has not conducted a population census since independence](<https://datalab.uneca.org/docs-acs/sites/default/files/ood-documents/Population-Summary.pdf>). It was published in the last twelve months. No census being prepared has been found, and no source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. An Eritrean Population and Health Survey 2025 and a Household Income and Expenditure Survey are named in a UNDP report, with no results dated. A census only promised does not count. Preparing would need a census being prepared, with mapping, a pilot, funding or a date set in the past three years.

No stage is set. The last census on record was counted in 2007, and [Addis Fortune said in June 2026 that none has been completed since](<https://addisfortune.news/national-census-delay-opens-a-new-fight-over-who-controls-the-facts>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No census in preparation has been found, and no source says none is being prepared. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that no population census has been counted in ten years and that none is being prepared.

[Gabon's national population and housing census (RGPL) has been enumerated](<https://www.gabonreview.com/rgpl-la-cour-constitutionnelle-lance-la-verification-des-chiffres-dans-les-neuf-provinces/>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026, the governor of Estuaire province reported census coverage above 95% in her province, in the same source. No count of the population from the census has been found. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published, or results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

The Ghana Statistical Service's [census page gives the 2021 Population and Housing Census as the latest national census](<https://www.statsghana.gov.gh/census-surveys/population-housing-census>) and offers its reports, with regional and district profiles. The page projects the next census for 2030. A [March 2025 progress form lists the Annual Household Income and Expenditure Survey among current surveys](<https://www.data4sdgs.org/sites/default/files/file_uploads/12_Ghana%20Statistical%20Service.pdf>) and cites its report on labour force participation, without a release date. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No national household survey result dated since October 2023 has been found. Mature would need such a survey, with results published in the past three years.

[Guinea's fourth general population census (RGPH-4) was conducted from 1 to 31 July 2025](<https://www.stat-guinee.org/index.php/actu/404-decret-de-publication-des-resultats-du-rgph-4>). In the last twelve months, [the Ministry of Plan, through INS, published preliminary results on 25 February 2026](<https://mpcid.gov.gn/index.php/rgph-4-la-guinee-revele-son-nouveau-visage-et-sancre-dans-la-gouvernance-par-la-donnee/>), giving a population of 17,521,167, and a presidential decree of 6 March 2026 gave them effect. Final results have not been found. A [post-enumeration survey launched on 30 October 2025](<https://mpcid.gov.gn/index.php/rgph-4-le-ministre-ismael-nabe-lance-officiellement-lenquete-post-censitaire-un-pas-decisif-vers-la-fiabilite-des-donnees-demographiques/>) assesses the census's coverage. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Mature would need a national household survey with results published in the past three years.

[On 17 September 2024 the Gambia Bureau of Statistics launched the preliminary report of the 2024 digital population and housing census](<https://gambia.unfpa.org/en/news/unfpa-joins-gambia-bureau-statistics-and-partners-launch-2024-digital-population-and-housing>), which gives a population of 2.4 million. Final results have not been found. In the last twelve months, the Bureau [lists the Gambia Labour Force Survey GLFS 2026 (Q1), with reports and microdata for download](<https://www.gbosdata.org/downloads>). It also [published a report comparing its labour force survey across three rounds, 2023 Q1, 2025 Q1 and 2026 Q1](<https://www.gbosdata.org/downloads-file/628-the-gambia-labour-market-progress-and-trends-2>).

[UNFPA states that Guinea-Bissau's first fully digital census, RGPH-4, was completed and its preliminary results presented on 23 July 2026](<https://guinea-bissau.unfpa.org/en/news/guinea-bissaus-future-numbers-preliminary-results-first-ever-fully-digital-census-unveiled>). In the last twelve months, [INE released those results after data collection closed](<https://ang.gw/ivo-rgph4-guine-bissau-conta-atualmente-com-2-191-300-habitantes-segundo-dados-preliminares-divulgados-hoje-pelo-ine/>), giving 2,191,300 residents, 304,939 households and 559,303 dwellings. Final results have not been found. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

[The National Statistics Council's 27 August 2026 session was to hear progress on the fifth General Population and Housing Census (CGPV-V)](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/el_consejo_nacional_de_estadistica_analiza_los_avances_de_las_principales_operaciones_estadisticas_del_pais>), authorised by Decree 25/2025 of 3 March. In the last twelve months, [the Scientific Committee validated the project document, communication strategy and resource-mobilisation strategy on 20 August 2026](<https://ahoraeg.com/politica/2026/08/20/el-comite-cientifico-valida-los-documentos-estrategicos-del-v-censo-de-poblacion-y-del-i-agropecuario/>). [INEGE held a workshop on 27 to 29 July 2026 to validate the project document and mobilisation strategies](<https://ahoraeg.com/politica/2026/07/28/el-inege-inicia-el-taller-de-validacion-de-los-documentos-estrategicos-del-v-censo-de-poblacion-y-viviendas-y-el-i-censo-general-agropecuario/>). No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[On 31 January 2025 the director general of KNBS said groundwork had been laid for the 2029 census](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/108566-knbs-rules-out-new-census-garissa-wajir-mandera-citing-4-year-preparation-time>), Kenya's seventh, after a court cancelled the results of the 2019 census for parts of Wajir, Mandera and Garissa. [Pollicy reported in 2025 that Kenya's open data portal gives free access to the 2019 census](<https://pollicy.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Policy-brief-13-Mar.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest survey found is the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey. [The Communications Authority published its ICT fact sheet in December 2024](<https://www.ca.go.ke/sites/default/files/2024-12/ICT-KDHS%20Analytical%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf>).

[LISGIS enumerated the 2022 Liberia Population and Housing Census, with census night on 11 November 2022 and a total enumerated population of 5,250,187](<https://lisgis.gov.lr/admin_area/uploads/census/CENSUS_PUBLICATION_20260826152056_039d1199.pdf>). It released preliminary results in February 2023 and later published the final results. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A Household Income and Expenditure Survey, a National Labor Force Survey and the 2019/2020 DHS are named in sources read, with no results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

[The Libya Observer reported in August 2024 that the Government of National Unity reviewed progress on the seventh national population census](<https://libyaobserver.ly/news/gnu-prepares-national-population-census>), the first since 2006. Libya had been divided into census areas. Preparations were said to be on track. In the last twelve months, [LibyaReview, citing Al Jazeera, said in July 2026 that political division had prevented the launch of a new census](<https://libyareview.com/67171/whats-preventing-libya-from-holding-a-new-population-census/>). The Ministry of Planning's statistics director says the same. No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[The government states that enumeration of the 2026 Housing and Population Census has concluded](<https://www.gov.ls/government/lesotho-completed-2026-housing-and-population-census-enumeration-successfully/>), with mop-up in Maseru and cattle pounds. In the last twelve months, [enumeration with reference night 11 April 2026 concluded, and over 8,000 temporary field staff were employed](<https://publiceyenews.com/2026/09/17/we-felt-like-part-of-the-basotho-census-gives-lgbtiq-community-a-place-in-national-data/>). [The Bureau of Statistics deployed enumerators](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91243>), with payment delays and an internal probe into enumerators outside the approved lists. The Bureau says results come after review, and none have been found. Its page [lists the Labour Force Survey 2024 Indicators as its latest release](<https://www.bos.gov.ls/publications.htm>). Operating would need preliminary or final results of the 2026 census published.

[The government adopted decree 2.24.1009 fixing Morocco's legal population from the RGPH 2024 results](<https://www.hcp.ma/Population-legale-du-Royaume-du-Maroc-repartie-par-regions-provinces-et-prefectures-et-communes-selon-les-resultats-du_a3974.html>), at 36,828,330 on 1 September 2024. [The census counted 36.8 million inhabitants, including 148,152 foreign residents](<https://www.hcp.ma/file/246070/>), with a new immigration module. In the last twelve months, HCP [published the first Q1 2026 results of the new national labour force survey (EMO2026)](<https://www.hcp.ma/Situation-du-marche-du-travail-au-Maroc-au-premier-trimestre-de-2026-a-partir-de-la-nouvelle-enquete-sur-la-main-d_a4309.html>). The survey replaces the Enquete nationale sur l'emploi and has an annual sample of 135,000 households.

[The third general population and housing census (RGPH-3) was held in 2018](<http://mail.mfb.gov.mg/page_personnalisee/index/news/1673>). In the last twelve months, [INSTAT presented the RGPH-4 project document to partners on 12 May 2026](<https://www.instat.mg/p/presentation-du-document-de-projet-prodoc-du-rgph-4>), with enumeration planned for 2028 and support from the World Bank's STATCAP II project and UNFPA. [A UN Madagascar account dated 5 March 2026 describes MICS7 2025 as a reference data source](<https://madagascar.un.org/fr/311176-madagascar-enqu%C3%AAte-par-grappes-%C3%A0-indicateurs-multiples-2025-et-les-objectifs-de>), carried out by INSTAT with UNICEF on 21,000 households. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[INSTAT's microdata catalogue lists the fifth general population and housing census (RGPH5) of Mali, dated 2022](<https://microdata.instat.ml/index.php/catalog/>). In the last twelve months, [INSTAT's Q4 2025 bulletin reported validation of the Directory of Localities of Mali, produced from RGPH5 data, on 16-18 December 2025 in Bamako](<https://www.instat-mali.org/laravel-filemanager/files/shares/pub/khideux51_pub.pdf>). [INSTAT published the 2025 annual report of the EMOP household survey in the second quarter of 2026](<https://www.instat-mali.org/storage/353/khideux53_pub.pdf>). No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

INE says [the last census, in 2017, counted just over 26 million people](<https://360mozambique.com/innovation/tech/mozambique-invests-430000-in-digital-census-pilot-ahead-of-2027-count/>). In the last twelve months, a [pilot census ran in Magude district in August 2026](<https://www.diarioeconomico.co.mz/2026/08/22/desenvolvimento-2/ine-quer-melhorar-sistema-digital-do-censo-de-2027-apos-falhas-nos-testes/>), ahead of the first digital census planned for 2027. In September 2026 INE's national planning meeting [put the preparation of the 2027 census at the centre of its agenda](<https://mznews.co.mz/ine-aposta-na-era-digital-e-prepara-censo-2027-em-reuniao-nacional-de-planificacao/>). No source found reports preliminary or final results of the 2017 census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[La Depeche reports that Mauritania's fifth general population and housing census counted nearly 5 million inhabitants](<https://www.cridem.org/C_Info.php?article=780743>). In the last twelve months, [a regional workshop opened in Nouadhibou on 18 February 2026 to disseminate the definitive results of the fifth RGPH 2023](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/289781>). [ANSADE held a workshop in Atar on 3 August 2026](<https://www.ami.mr/archives/265803>), where it presented the final results for Adrar wilaya. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A 2025 EPCV survey is named in a source read, with no results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

[Statistics Mauritius says its labour force estimates from 2025 use population figures revised to the results of the 2022 population census](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/Statistics/ESI/2026/EI1925/LF_Emp_Unemp_Yr25_190526.pdf>). In the last twelve months, its [first-quarter 2026 labour force report says the census results were used to review sampling strata from 2023](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/Statistics/ESI/2026/EI1936/LF_Emp_Unemp_1Qtr26_300626.pdf>). [Statistics Mauritius released its ICT statistics report on 10 July 2026, with 2024 results of the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/Statistics/ESI/2026/EI1939/ICT_Yr25_100726.pdf>). No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[Malawi held a 2018 Population and Housing Census](<https://efficacynews.africa/2026/09/10/zamstats-hosts-malawi-statistical-office-for-census-knowledge-exchange/>). In the last twelve months, the same report says Malawi is preparing its 7th census, scheduled for September 2028, and its statistics office held a benchmarking mission in Zambia on 7 to 11 September 2026. [Finance minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said the coming census and related economic surveys are budgeted at about $55 million](<https://mwnation.com/afdb-backs-malawi-on-census-gdp-rebasing/>), with the US Census Bureau, UK ONS and UNFPA expected to co-finance them. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[The NSA released the 2023 Population and Housing Census Main Report on 30 October 2024](<https://nsa.org.na/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Media-Statement-2023-Census-Main-Report-30-October-2024.pdf>), which it says contains final results. Census night was 24 September 2023, and the population was 3,022,401. Preliminary results had been launched in March 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. The Namibia Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2015/16 and the Labour Force Survey 2016 are among surveys named, with no recent results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

[On 8 October 2025 the acting head of the statistics institute INS said Niger's fifth census was fully financed with partners and in active preparation](<https://www.lesahel.org/7e-congres-ordinaire-du-syndicat-national-du-personnel-de-linformation-statistique-synpis-le-recensement-general-de-la-population-le-bilan-du-mandat-ecoule-et-le-renouvellement-du-b/>), with a budget above 35 billion FCFA. The INS [reported continued pilot enumeration on 7 April 2025](<https://www.stat-niger.org/?p=5392>). A [UNFPA posting set a field pretest for July 2025 and the start of enumeration for December 2025](<https://www.unfpa.org/jobs/consultant-international-en-infrastructure-et-s%C3%A9curit%C3%A9-informatique>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[Nigeria's last national census was held in November 2006](<https://www.thisdaylive.com/2025/03/08/nigerias-first-biometric-census>). The next is being prepared as the country's first digital census. In the last twelve months, [a minister said in October 2026 that the National Population Commission had mapped more than 65 million properties for the count](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7586/x>). [By March 2025 the Commission had mapped and demarcated the whole country and trained staff](<https://www.thisdaylive.com/2025/03/08/nigerias-first-biometric-census>), and a budget of N980 billion had been proposed to the President. No date for the count has been found. No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[NISR states the Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census was enumerated from 16 to 30 August 2022](<http://alpha.statistics.gov.rw/sites/default/files/documents/2025-02/RPHC5_MainIndicatorsReport_Final.pdf>), and published its Main Indicators Report in February 2023. [A March 2025 presentation gives the count as 13,246,394 people in 3,312,743 households](<https://spdci.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Talking-Interoperability-18-Rwanda_vFinal_Updated.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [NISR announced the release of the 2025 Demographic and Health Survey on 6 January 2026](<https://statistics.gov.rw/node/805>). Its [final report was published in 2026](<https://dhsprogram.com/pubs/pdf/FR401/FR401.pdf>). [NISR added the 2025 Labour Force Survey microdata to its catalogue on 8 April 2026](<https://microdatabk.statistics.gov.rw/home>).

No stage is set. The last census on record was counted in 2008. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No census in preparation since October 2023 has been found, and no source says none is being prepared. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that no population census has been counted in ten years and that none is being prepared.

[ANSD's national data archive lists the fifth general population and housing census, Senegal 2023 (RGPH-5), as a catalogued dataset](<http://anads.ansd.sn/index.php/catalog>). [The ENTICS sample was drawn from the base of the 2023 census](<https://www.rewmi.com/enquete-nationale-sur-les-tic-au-senegal-entics-les-femmes-plus-connectees-que-les-hommes/>), and [a DGPSN presentation gives Senegal's population as 18,000,000 from it](<https://spdci.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Talking-Interoperability-13-Senegal-Eng-revised.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. ANSD's archive also lists the national employment survey first quarter 2025 as a dataset, last modified 21 October 2025. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[Statistics Sierra Leone published the final results of the 2021 Mid-Term Population and Housing Census in a report dated September 2022](<https://statistics.sl/images/StatisticsSL/Documents/Census/MTPHC_Preliminary_Report/Final_Preliminary_Report_2021_MTPHC.pdf>), counting 7,548,702 people. In the last twelve months, [Stats SL announced on 7 October 2026 that it was deploying 500 tablets and mapping software](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/stats-mapping-deploys-digital-system-census/>). It said the cartographic mapping begun in October 2025 was complete. [A mock census enumeration was closing on 19 October 2026](<https://www.statistics.sl/index.php/minister-of-planning-economic-development-statistician-general-and-unfpa-country-representative-undertake-joint-monitoring-visit-to-2026-mock-population-and-housing-census-area.html>). The national census is scheduled for December 2026. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. Mature would need a national household survey with results published in the past three years.

[In April 2025 WorldPop trained Somali statisticians to map pre-census enumeration areas in five districts](<https://www.worldpop.org/blog/building-census-readiness-geospatial-training-boosts-capacity-for-somali-statisticians/>), with full enumeration to follow if security permits. [Since August 2024 the Gates Foundation has funded UNFPA to collect pre-census enumeration data for population modelling](<https://d-portal.iatistandard.org/ctrack.html#view=act&aid=DAC-1601-INV-070843>). [The World Bank lists 1987 as the year of the latest census](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037712/world-development-indicators>). In the last twelve months, [UNDP in April 2026 quoted the Director General of the statistics bureau naming the Socioeconomic and Demographic Survey among its outputs](<https://undpinsomalia.medium.com/promoting-innovation-and-digital-transformation-in-somalia-db2d48bc9643>). No census counted since October 2016 has been found. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[With UNFPA support the Bureau of Statistics prepared a census dossier and an operations manual in 2025](<https://amnon.co.uk/2026/01/14/bureau-of-statistics-launches-new-website-as-south-sudans-data-capacity-grows/>). [Radio Tamazuj quotes the chair of the National Bureau of Statistics saying the Council of Ministers approved the census budget](<https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/qa-census-should-be-rolled-out-before-elections-dr-ting>). It is still awaiting funding. In the last twelve months, [the Bureau and UNICEF released the 2025 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey on 21 April 2026](<https://www.eyeradio.org/s-sudan-first-ever-survey-exposes-gaps-in-women-and-children-services/>), covering more than 10,000 households. No census counted since October 2016 has been found, and no date set for the next. Establishing would need a population census counted in the past ten years, with no results out yet.

[INE released the final data of the fifth general population and housing census on 25 July 2025](<https://rstp.st/2025/07/26/sao-tome-e-principe-tem-quase-210-mil-residentes-e-regista-aumento-drastico-da-emigracao-ine/>). It counted 212,017 people on 15 November 2024, of whom 209,607 were the legal resident population. The [enumeration ran from 15 November to 15 December 2024](<https://www.ine.st/phocadownload/userupload/Documentos/Recenseamentos/2024/Resultado_VRGPH%202024.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A [March 2026 article](<https://www.telanon.info/sociedade/2026/03/26/52331/pobreza-extrema-atinge-milhares-de-familias-em-sao-tome-e-principe/>) cites the 2017 household budget survey. Mature would need a national household survey with results published in the past three years.

[The minister said the last population and housing census was conducted in 2017 and was the country's first digital census](<https://times.co.sz/27831/news/ministry-unfpa-launch-population-housing-economic-census/>). [In November 2025 the planning ministry and UNFPA launched the 2027 Population and Housing Census](<https://times.co.sz/27831/news/ministry-unfpa-launch-population-housing-economic-census/>), and the Central Statistical Office is running its first phase, mapping and listing. No other change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the 2017 census published. [An August 2019 profile listed MICS5 from 2014 as a national health survey](<https://measureevaluation.cpc.unc.edu/his-strengthening-resource-center/country-profiles-1/swaziland.html>). Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[The NBS published Volume 2, the main report of the 2022 Population and Housing Census, with results at national, regional and district level, in March 2024](<https://www.nbs.gov.sc/downloads/1555-seychelles-population-and-housing-census-2022/download>). The census was Seychelles' sixth since independence and its first digital one. [The NBS benchmarks its population estimates to it](<https://www.nbs.gov.sc/downloads/1889-mid-2025-estimated-resident-population/download>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports results of a national household survey published since October 2023. A Quarterly Labour Force Survey is named in a source read, with no results dated. Mature would need a national household survey (DHS, MICS, living standards or labour force) with results published in the past three years.

[INSEED states that collection operations of the third general population and housing census (RGPH-3) officially ended on 6 August 2026](<https://www.inseed.td/>). It was the country's first fully digital census. In the last twelve months, [a few days before the count closed, the national coordinator for nomadic populations found in Batha that no enumerator had yet reached one herder camp](<https://lendjampost.com/rgph-3-dans-le-batha-une-mission-de-terrain-pour-ne-laisser-aucun-nomade-de-cote/>), and ordered a team sent. No source found reports preliminary or final results of the census published. Operating would need preliminary or final results of that census published.

[INSEED published the definitive results of RGPH-5 (November 2022) by region, prefecture, sex and urban/rural, totalling 8,095,498 residents](<https://inseed.tg/resultats-definitifs-du-rgph-5-novembre-2022/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is a workshop on 13 December 2024. [It presented detailed results of the second harmonised household living conditions survey (EHCVM-2), with fieldwork in 2021-2022](<https://archive.presidence.gouv.tg/2024/12/14/developpement-presentation-des-principaux-resultats-du-rgph-5-et-de-la-ehcvm-2/>). The RGPH-5 results were presented alongside them.

[Tunisia's Institut National de la Statistique announced the publication of the official results of the 2024 general population and housing census](<http://www.ins.tn/event_rgph2024>) at a press conference on 17 May 2025. [INS gives 2024 census housing counts of 4,265,636 dwellings](<https://www.ins.tn/sites/default/files-ftp3/files/publication/pdf/LOGEMENTS-FR.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest survey found is the 2023 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey. [The economy ministry, the INS and UNICEF presented its results on 12 February 2024](<https://www.unicef.org/tunisia/communiqu%C3%A9s-de-presse/publication-des-r%C3%A9sultats-de-lenqu%C3%AAte-nationale-par-grappe-%C3%A0-indicateurs>), covering 11,000 households with a 90% response rate.

[Tanzania released its 2022 census report within 45 days of data collection, the Statistician General said in March 2024](<https://dailynews.co.tz/statistical-master-plan-implementation-on-track/>). [A March 2026 TCRA presentation gives 61,741,120 people in 14,152,803 private households](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/sites/projectumc/wp-content/uploads/sites/42/2026/03/Tanzania-UMC-workshop.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the NBS microdata catalogue released the Integrated Labour Force Survey 2025 on 15 July 2026 as edited final data for public use](<https://microdata.nbs.go.tz/index.php/catalog/65>), covering 14,232 households. No source found says whether the census report released in 2022 gave preliminary or final results.

[UBOS states the National Population and Housing Census 2024 was enumerated door-to-door from 10 to 26 May 2024](<https://www.ubos.org/wp-content/uploads/publications/National-Population-and-Housing-Census-2024-Final-Report-Volume-1-Main.pdf>), counting 45,905,417 persons and 10,698,913 households. Its final report, Volume I, is dated December 2024. No change to the census results has been found in the last twelve months. UBOS's budget report for 2025/26 says it is [finalising and disseminating a disability monograph from the census](<https://budget.finance.go.ug/sites/default/files/Sector%20Spending%20Agency%20Budgets%20and%20Performance/Uganda%20Bureau%20of%20Statistics_25.pdf>) and producing thematic reports from the 2022 Demographic and Health Survey.

[Statistics South Africa states Census 2022 was enumerated with reference night 2 February 2022](<https://census.statssa.gov.za/assets/documents/2022/P03014_Census_2022_Statistical_Release.pdf>), and counted 62,027,503 people. It [released the first phase of the results in October 2023](<https://www.gov.za/news/media-statements/statistics-south-africa-census-2022-results-october-2023-22-aug-2024>) and has since published thematic reports. It has withheld some themes, such as income and labour. In the last twelve months, it [released the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the second quarter of 2026, with fieldwork from April to June 2026](<https://www.statssa.gov.za/publications/P0211/P02112ndQuarter2026.pdf>). The sample is about 30,000 dwellings, and the survey reports an unemployment rate of 33.6%.

[Zambia's 2022 Census of Population and Housing, its sixth national census, was enumerated from 18 August to 21 September 2022](<https://www.zamstats.gov.zm/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/2022-Census-of-Population-and-Housing-Summary-Report-Part-2.pdf>). The Population Summary Report Volume Two, dated June 2024, gives final figures with a total of 19,693,423. No change to the census results has been found in the last twelve months. In that time, [ZamStats presented highlights of the 2025 National Survey on Access and Usage of ICTs](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/sites/projectumc/wp-content/uploads/sites/42/2026/03/Zambia_2025-ICT-Survey.pdf>), a household survey of 32,500 individuals targeted in 325 enumeration areas.

[The Herald reports that Zimbabwe's Population and Housing Census was taken in April 2022](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/digital-inclusivity-leaving-no-place-no-person-behind/>). ZIMSTAT's 2025 environment statistics report [cites the final census report](<https://www.zimstat.co.zw/wp-content/uploads/production/environment/2026/2025%20Environment_Statistics_Human_Settlement_report.pdf>) for a count of 15,178,957 people. Of them, 61.4 percent live in rural areas. In the last twelve months, ZIMSTAT and POTRAZ [released the 2025 ICT Access by Households and Use by Individuals Survey in July 2026](<https://www.newsday.co.zw/local-news/article/200058521/mobile-internet-access-surges-as-zimbabwe-embraces-digital-shift>), covering 9,245 households in all ten provinces.
